name: convention-intermediate-key-not-followed
description: A key along a property's path whose value names a top-level constant is not read through the constant's declaration, so the run ends with the convention-not-literal setup failure naming the configuration file and the property. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named nuxt for the package nuxt, holding the installed version in its range, whose pages directory the dir.pages property of nuxt.config.ts moves.
